role-accepted-intent.subject: accepted-intent
role-accepted-intent.value: Defines the canonical product behavior and explicit limits.

role-implementation.subject: implementation
role-implementation.value: Owns current executable behavior and boundaries.

role-runtime-observation.subject: runtime-observation
role-runtime-observation.value: Require executed digest-bound results; test source alone is not observation.

role-evidence.subject: evidence
role-evidence.value: Supports only the exact subject and predicate it records.

role-source-adapter.subject: source-adapter
role-source-adapter.value: Maps explicit source facts without inventing intent.

role-source-bundle.subject: source-bundle
role-source-bundle.value: Binds selected bytes, source identity, revision, and provenance.

role-claim-model.subject: claim-model
role-claim-model.value: Owns typed assertions, planes, conditions, scope, unknowns, and contradictions.

role-edition.subject: edition
role-edition.value: Owns audience, questions, coverage, omissions, narrative, and visual grammar.

role-build-request.subject: build-request
role-build-request.value: Binds one exact Source Bundle, Claim Model, Edition, and output selection.

role-publisher-core.subject: publisher-core
role-publisher-core.value: Composes standard contracts and remains independent of concrete Editions.

role-uncertainty.subject: uncertainty
role-uncertainty.value: Broadens obligations instead of being hidden by presentation.

role-static-artifact.subject: static-artifact
role-static-artifact.value: Names the required final static delivery; a build result, qualification, and publication remain separate.

role-static-renderer.subject: static-renderer
role-static-renderer.value: Translates the static scene into vector bytes without owning meaning.

role-interactive-scenes.subject: interactive-scenes
role-interactive-scenes.value: Own complete overview and mechanism compositions independently.

role-interactive-atlas.subject: interactive-atlas
role-interactive-atlas.value: Packages complete responsive overview and mechanism pages with source inspection.

role-interactive-renderer.subject: interactive-renderer
role-interactive-renderer.value: Translates interactive scenes into standalone HTML without owning meaning.

role-edition-candidate.subject: edition-candidate
role-edition-candidate.value: Binds exact source, semantics, Edition, scenes, renderer supply, and emitted bytes.

role-qualification-set.subject: qualification-set
role-qualification-set.value: Validates non-compensating judgments over exact subjects without granting authority.

role-human-review.subject: human-review
role-human-review.value: Must judge faithful, intelligible, and restrained for exact artifact bytes.

role-acceptance.subject: acceptance
role-acceptance.value: Records an explicit decision over exact qualified artifact bytes.

role-authorization.subject: authorization
role-authorization.value: Permits one exact publication plan without becoming semantic truth.

role-publication.subject: publication
role-publication.value: Applies an exact bounded reader delivery; it is not hosted or release proof.

role-recovery.subject: recovery
role-recovery.value: Resumes or confirms an interrupted exact filesystem publication.

role-off-host-recovery.subject: off-host-recovery
role-off-host-recovery.value: Remains unproved until an operator selects custody and destination.

role-self-consumer.subject: self-consumer
role-self-consumer.value: Prepares portable self-model inputs; flagship acceptance remains separate work.

role-ethos-consumer.subject: ethos-consumer
role-ethos-consumer.value: Consumes generic contracts without transferring ETHOS authority.

role-aigw-consumer.subject: aigw-consumer
role-aigw-consumer.value: Demonstrates a materially different source-owned consumer and semantic evolution.

role-feedback.subject: feedback
role-feedback.value: Returns findings through each source owner rather than mutating source truth.

role-evolution-inputs.subject: evolution-inputs
role-evolution-inputs.value: Bind before and after Claim Models, Editions, and explicit correspondences.

role-semantic-delta.subject: semantic-delta
role-semantic-delta.value: Reports meaning change and dependency reach without performing effects.

role-affected-views.subject: affected-views
role-affected-views.value: Identifies impacted views and broadens work on unknown coverage.

role-rebuild-obligations.subject: rebuild-obligations
role-rebuild-obligations.value: Names candidate and medium rebuilds without executing them.

role-semantic-verification-obligations.subject: semantic-verification-obligations
role-semantic-verification-obligations.value: Requires renewed semantic and coverage verification.

role-medium-verification-obligations.subject: medium-verification-obligations
role-medium-verification-obligations.value: Requires renewed medium, installed-use, or recovery verification.

role-human-review-obligations.subject: human-review-obligations
role-human-review-obligations.value: Requires renewed exact-artifact visual judgment when affected.

role-acceptance-obligations.subject: acceptance-obligations
role-acceptance-obligations.value: Requires explicit acceptance or withdrawal after change.

role-publication-obligations.subject: publication-obligations
role-publication-obligations.value: Requires publication, replacement, or withdrawal without performing it.

product-contract.authority: Canonical product meaning and authority boundary

edition-contract.authority: Canonical Edition authorship and coverage boundary

ethos-source-owned-handoff.authority: Immutable ETHOS source-ownership and adoption evidence

aigw-source-owned-handoff.authority: Immutable AIGW source-ownership and adoption evidence

core-package.authority: Installed generic product identity and public package surface

self-prepare-owner.authority: Explicit self-Edition source selection and preparation

self-static-metrics.authority: Recorded typography input; not fresh runtime observation

self-interactive-composition-owner.authority: Flagship interactive visual-carrier composition and routing

self-interactive-atlas-owner.authority: Flagship standalone Atlas composition and source-inspection owner

source-owner.authority: Source Bundle validation and exclusive output implementation

claim-owner.authority: Claim Model schema, validation, and canonical identity owner

evolution-owner.authority: Semantic delta and Edition evolution obligation compiler

installed-test-owner.authority: Installed-use test implementation; not an execution observation

context.authority: Source owners retain truth and lifecycle authority; this Edition selects and communicates exact claims.
context.excluded: Repository mutation, source acceptance, implicit intent inference, current flagship acceptance, hosted observation, and unproved off-host recovery.
